summary: 9 film announcements, 13 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Deep End
film.talent: Shawn Levy (21 Laps), Alex Cooper (Unwell Productions)
film.announcement: Netflix acquired the film adaptation rights to Ali Hazelwood's hot new adult romance novel with Shawn Levy's 21 Laps and Alex Cooper's Unwell Productions producing.

film.title: Thud
film.talent: Sarah Michelle Gellar, Rudy Pankow, Brandon Scott, Vincent Rodriguez III
film.announcement: The grim reaper-devil romance film rounded out its cast with six final additions including Brandon Scott and Vincent Rodriguez III.

film.title: Doctor Caligari's Cabinet of Wonders
film.announcement: Talia Ryder joined Michael Shannon in the film adaptation of the classic expressionist horror tale.

film.title: Exit to the Guillotine
film.announcement: The psychological thriller starring Peyton List and Gustaf Skarsgård wrapped filming.

film.title: Diya
film.announcement: Paramount is developing an animated Bollywood-focused musical produced by Jonathan Goldstein and John Francis Daley.

film.title: Wildwood
film.announcement: Laika's stop-motion adventure film set in Portland released a poster teasing the project.

film.title: The Bridge
film.announcement: Kevin Bright-produced October 7 survivors documentary set North American release date.

film.title: Theater Kids Vs. Zombies
film.announcement: Jesse Tyler Ferguson and Justin Mikita are prepping a musical microdrama for aTwist.

film.title: The Work In Progress
film.announcement: Documentary from EP Robert Reich had trailer released, aimed at helping bridge America's deepest divides.

tv.title: I Love LA
tv.talent: Taron Egerton, Jamie Chung, Milan Carter
tv.announcement: Season 2 cast additions announced with Taron Egerton, Jamie Chung, and Milan Carter joining as guest stars.

tv.title: Gilmore Girls Documentary
tv.announcement: Documentary in development for HBO Max featuring Lauren Graham, never-before-seen footage, and involvement from creator Amy Sherman-Palladino.

tv.title: The Five Star Weekend
tv.announcement: Series renewed for Season 2 after becoming Peacock's most-watched scripted series ever.

tv.title: The Secret of Secrets
tv.talent: Cherry Jones, Corey Stoll, Rob Delaney, Abbey Lee
tv.announcement: Cast announced for Netflix's Dan Brown novel TV adaptation with Cherry Jones, Corey Stoll, Rob Delaney, and Abbey Lee.

tv.title: Trauma
tv.announcement: Richard Madden cast to star in medical hostage thriller series for Paramount+ and Prime Video UK.

tv.title: The Varnell Hill Show
tv.announcement: Martin spinoff set September release date and dropped first look photos.
HBO and BBC team for drama series written by Ava Pickett.

tv.title: Holiday Touchdown: Bears Love Story
tv.announcement: Hallmark movie in the Holiday Touchdown franchise starring Lyndsy Fonseca and Robert Buckley.

tv.title: Adam's Law
tv.announcement: Judy Sheindlin's new show announced with fall premiere date set.

tv.title: High Value Target: The Hunt for Saddam
tv.announcement: Joel Kinnaman interrogates Saddam Hussein in trailer for the series.

tv.title: Carnival of the Animals
tv.announcement: PBS Kids and Gustavo Dudamel partner on 2D animated special.

tv.title: The Challenge: Cutthroat II
tv.announcement: Season 42 cast announced for the reality competition series.
